messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager S1: elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts across hosted-api EU/US regions. Start ~03:58 UTC. Symptoms: gateway 502/504 spikes, backend quota-service responding 429, cascading retries. Pager sent to oncall @maria.

maria: Ack, I'm on it. Quick status anyone?

alex: seeing huge 429 waterfall from quota-service. Spike aligns with rollout 'quota-tightening-v2' at 03:55 UTC. Logs: `quota-service` returning 429 for auth tokens then gateway marks upstream as unhealthy -> 502.

sasha: pulling pod events now. One quota-service pod restarted repeatedly, OOM at 03:56:59. Kube events: `oomkilled` after new memory limit applied by the rollout.

maria: timeline suggests regression from deploy. Can we pause traffic to quota-service or revert?

devops-bot: deploy: rollout pause requested for deployment/quota-service in namespace infra by sasha.

alex: attempting immediate rollback to previous replica set (rev 4) and bumping replicas to 4 while we stabilize:
```
kubectl rollout undo deployment/quota-service -n infra --to-revision=4
kubectl scale deployment/quota-service -n infra --replicas=4
```

sasha: done. New pods coming up. Also adding temporary rate override for top-impacted tenants to reduce customer 429s while we stabilize:
```
adminctl tenants modify --id=acme-corp --rate=500 --burst=1000
adminctl tenants modify --id=beta-inc --rate=300 --burst=800
```

maria: Good. Also enable gateway slow-start and open circuit breaker to short-circuit downstream failures: POST /admin/gateway/cb?state=enabled -> 200.

alex: metrics look better after rollback+scale+CB. 5xx rate down from 6.8% to 0.6% over 4 minutes. P95 latency falling.

tilly: support: affected customers list? we need to coordinate proactive outreach.

sasha: impacted tenants (by error count): acme-corp, beta-inc, gamma-startups. Acme had sustained 60% error rate for ~7m. Sent alert to account team for acme to prepare blast.

maria: Can we confirm root cause? Was the new memory limit the only change?

alex: rollout applied two changes: memory cap reduced from 1.5Gi -> 512Mi and new GC tuning flags. Under burst traffic this caused repeated OOMs, failed quota checks -> 429 -> gateway errors. Also noticed retry storm from clients with short backoffs magnified the fanout.

devops-bot: monitoring: quota-service pod OOM alerts triggered (kube-event), restarted 3x.

maria: Immediate mitigations summary: 1) rollback rollout, 2) scale replicas to 4, 3) enable gateway circuit-breaker, 4) apply temporary tenant rate overrides, 5) throttle client retry policy via gateway short-circuit header.

tilly: drafting customer comms now. I'll post to #support and email acme-corp with ETA and apology.

alex: follow-ups proposed: revert memory/Gflag changes permanently, add canary window + load test for quota-service changes, add OOM alert with 3-restart threshold, add a deploy checklist entry: memory cap verify + traffic simulation. Also consider soft-fallthrough for failed quota-checks to return degrade mode instead of 429 in short outage.

maria: assigning postmortem to @alex. Please include timeline, impact table (by tenant and duration), and action items. Recommend 24h draft.

alex: taking postmortem. Will create INC ticket and notify eng-sre and product.

incident-bot: Incident S1 mitigated — gateway circuit-breaker active, quota-service rolled back and scaled, tenant overrides applied. Pager cleared. Handing to postmortem owner @alex for follow-up.

tilly: once postmortem is filed, I'll coordinate the customer outreach message and make sure account teams have the incident summary.

maria: closing thread, keep channel open for any late changes. Great response team. :heart:
